FULL TEXT:
SHRI MATA VAISHNO DEVI UNIVERSITY
Kakryal, Katra – 182320 (J&K)
(Ranked among top 100 Engineering & Management Intitutions and among top 150 Universities in the
NIRF 2019 ranking of MHRD, GoI.)
Advertisement for recruitment of staff under ICSSR funded Project
Project Title:- An Empirical Study of Bank Credit Risk Management Using Big Data
Analytics
Applications are invited for the position of Research Associate/ Research Assistant
under above refereed project purely on temporary & contractual basis for a period of
01 Year (further extendable till completion of the project).
No. Of Positions: 01
Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. / M.Phill/ M.B.A. or equivalent post graduate degree
with minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Candidates with
NET/SLET/M.Phill/Ph.D. in management or related areas will be given preference and
may be considered for the post of Research Associate.
Desirable Qualifications: B.Tech./ B.E. in computer Science or related field / M.B.A.
Desirable Skills:
1. Knowledge of machines learing techniques with exposure to software like ‘R’,
Python or Hadoop;
2. Experience with data analysis and problem solving with large amounts of data;
3. Knowledge of banking
Remuneration:
i. Research Associate: Rs. 25,000/- pm
ii. Research Assistant: Rs. 20,000/- pm
How to Apply: Eligible candidates may forward their complete Bio-data to the Email
Id: ashu.vashishtha@smvdu.ac.in within two weeks from the date of publishing this
advertisement. Interview date will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates through
Email.
For details please visit our website: www.smvdu.ac.in
Ref. No.: SMVDU/IRDU/19/584 , Dtd: 18/9/2019
Sd/- Dr. Ashutosh Vashishtha , PD, RP-109
